descripcion_geo: Kingdom east of the Dead Sea, on the high plateaus of Transjordan between the Arnon and Zéred rivers.
importancia_estrategica: Control of the Transjordan caravan routes and agricultural production on the plateaus.

historias.descripcion: Ruth, a Moabite widow, returns to Bethlehem with her mother-in-law Naomi and marries Boaz; She is an ancestor of David.
Israel camps in Moab's fields before crossing the Jordan; There Moses dies and Joshua is designated successor.
King Mesha of Moab rebels against Israel; The Mesa stele is one of the most important epigraphic testimonies of the OT.

personajes.descripcion: Her loyalty to Naomi and Israel made her a model of conversion and loyal love.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Town related to Israel (descendant of Lot); They worshiped Chemosh. Their land was the scene of the death of Moses and the origin of Ruth.
